Task Name: [Case Management – Case Intake] PBI001 — Create a new case
Description:
User Story: As an investigator, I want to create a new case and enter its core details so that I can start working on it inside Adheed.

Acceptance Criteria:
*   Core fields can be entered: case number, case type, report date and time, location, short description, case status
*   Required core fields must be filled before the case can be created
*   A unique case ID is generated
*   The new case appears in the cases list
*   The user can open the case file immediately after creating it
*   The case status is clearly visible
